verdict.rationale: Vercel's own docs describe an invisible bot-protection check (an 'invisible CAPTCHA') that protects routes from sophisticated bots without showing users a visible challenge, which matches the story directly. The evidence is only two short marketing-level lines with no setup or depth detail. Missing for 10: integration/setup documentation (SDK or route configuration), detail on how the invisible challenge verifies clients and handles failures, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can protect my app from automated bot traffic with invisible challenge-based protection

citations.quote: An invisible CAPTCHA that protects against sophisticated bots without challenges.
Protect sensitive routes from sophisticated bots with an invisible check instead of a CAPTCHA.
